About this item

  • HD Polarized Lens: KALIYADI polarized sunglasses men feature advanced polarization technology, which effectively eliminates glare, blocks UV rays and enhances contrast, providing you with crystal clear sight and reducing eye strain. Whether you are driving, hiking, or just lounging by the pool, these mens polarized sunglasses will give you the protection and clarity you need
  • Classic Rectangular Design: With a sleek and modern design, KALIYADI men's sunglasses polarized are perfect for any occasion. Whether you are dressing up for a party out or going casual for a day at the beach, these sunglasses men polarized will complement any outfit and help you make a statement. The frames are lightweight and comfortable, making polarized sunglasses ideal for all-day wear
  • Premium Materials: Made from high-quality materials, KALIYADI men sunglasses polarized are built to last. The frames are made from durable and lightweight materials, ensuring that they will stand up to wear and tear over time. The lenses are scratch-resistant and shatterproof, providing you with the ultimate protection and durability. Whether you are looking for style, functionality, or both, these polarized sunglasses for men are the perfect choice
  • Perfect All Round: KALIYADI men polarized sunglasses are versatile and can be worn in a variety of settings. Whether you are running errands, playing sports, or just enjoying a day in the sun, these sunglasses for men polarized will provide you with the necessary protection and style. KALIYADI rectangular sunglasses for men are perfect for both men and women, and the unisex design ensures that they will look great on anyone
  • Gift Idea Package and Brand Customer Service: Classic men's polarized sunglasses*3, microfiber pouch*3, microfiber glasses cleaning cloth*3, gift box*1. Our sunglasses for men women are also gift packed, which will be great gifts for your family and friends! All KALIYADI customers enjoy brand customer service for our sun glasses men. The integrity of every box and the quality of the lenses are double checked by third-party companies. And that goes with a lifetime support

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyzed reviews to verify trustworthiness.

5 out of 5 stars
Great Sunglasses for the Price
I've been really happy with these sunglasses, especially for the price. They fit comfortably and look great, and the lenses do a good job in bright sunlight. I can also tell a difference with the polarization, although I wouldn't say the glare reduction is dramatically better than every other pair I've owned. The biggest selling point for me is the value. I have a bad habit of losing sunglasses, so I don't like spending a lot on them. These are inexpensive enough that I'm not worried about losing them, but they don't look or feel like cheap sunglasses. They work well, look good, and are comfortable to wear. For the price, these are a great option if you're looking for an inexpensive pair of sunglasses that still looks and performs well.

    4 out of 5 stars
    Only good for driving
    Reviewed in the United States on August 7, 2026
    Color: (3 Pack) Black/Black/Black
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Great for driving, but I won’t be wearing them outside. So a really good pair of glasses is made of one solid material and if that material is flat black then that’s what it is. These are plastic with a coating that makes them black. The issue is that coating looks really weird if you have oily skin because it will be shiny where it touches your nose. As an example, check the photos, one I just touched to my forehead and you can see just how bad it shows. In the second image, I had wiped it down with a cloth and you can still see exactly where it was. These work just fine for my purposes of driving but that’s it. I can confirm they are comfortable for long trips in the car because they don’t apply too much pressure to the temples which means no headache from the pressure. They are light enough that they don’t slide down your nose either. Glare reduction is fine, the polarization is doing its job making them ideal for the road during mornings and evenings. I haven’t noticed any scratches, but I will update if that changes. If there is one gripe that I have, it’s the finish on these.
